svg.text: How many eggs does a new 100 m² home cost?
Price per m² × 100 ÷ farm-gate price of one hen egg (60 g) · shared log scale
Data: BIS residential property prices (WS_DPP levels, WS_SPP indices); researched anchor prices per m² (listed with sources and confidence in the spreadsheet's About sheet); FAOSTAT Producer
Solid: observed BIS price levels (France, Russia, Poland, Norway) or the anchor year; dashed: chained from one anchor with the BIS index. Anchor definitions differ (new vs all dwellings, national
vs big cities) — compare trends more than levels.
